class R:
    def __init__(s,seed): s.x=seed
    def nxt(s,n): s.x=(1103515245*s.x+12345)%(2**31); return s.x%n
r=R(7)
ts=[t for _,_,t in sub]
hits=0; sizes=[]
for it in range(200):
    a=ts[:]
    for i in range(len(a)-1,0,-1):
        j=r.nxt(i+1); a[i],a[j]=a[j],a[i]
    s=sorted([(u,v,a[i]) for i,(u,v,_) in enumerate(sub)], key=lambda e:e[2])
    ok,n=reach(s); hits+=ok; sizes.append(n)
print("time-shuffle hits/200:", hits, "mean reachset", sum(sizes)/len(sizes))
# static reach ignoring time
adj=collections.defaultdict(set)
for u,v,t in sub: adj[u].add(v)
seen={303}; st=[303]

    for y in adj[x]:
